items.title: Candido Camero — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Oh Billie Holiday, I did several radio programs accompanying her and at the Apollo Theater I also accompanied her.

ctx.x: Oh Billie Holiday, I did several radio programs accompanying her and at the Apollo Theater I also accompanied her. Corporan:What era?
That was 1952. In Atlantic City and I also accompanied her in the club . . . Club Harlem in Atlantic City. I accompanied her here at the Apollo theater and then in Newark at a radio station.
